provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 the beach town is xã Cần Giờ, the old Long Hòa commune and Cần Thạnh town joined. Thạnh An remains its own commune in the reserve.
dotReason: Worth the night for the mangrove creek and the market by the sand.

seoTitle: Can Gio travel guide — mangrove creek and the ferry
seoDescription: The mangrove creeks are the reason to stay, southeast of Ho Chi Minh City. The road is about 1 hour 30 minutes or about 2 hours, then the Bình Khánh ferry.
intro: You come for a mangrove creek at first light, dark water ahead of the boat and trunks closing overhead. Stay the night in the beach town if that forest is the trip. Sleep in Ho Chi Minh City if the city is the trip, and come out only when you can give the reserve a day. The crossing is still the Bình Khánh ferry.

Leave early. On 30 April 2026 a holiday queue on Huỳnh Tấn Phát ran nearly two hours, and one traveler counted nearly three hours including the wait. On the water the crossing is about 10–15 minutes, about 1.2 km on the Soài Rạp. After the ferry, đường Rừng Sác is the forest road a 2019 market story calls about 30 km of trees. Visit HCMC prints the Sac Forest gate as 7:30–17:30. Vàm Sát’s own gate is 8:00–17:00 every day. They are different desks.

The evening is chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, beside bãi 30 tháng 4. A 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m from the market. You point at a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. A bar street was not named. If you are still in town in the morning, Lăng Ông Thủy Tướng is the whale temple. A ticket and an opening hour were not printed. Check on arrival.
gettingAround: Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km from the city centre to the forest, via Nguyễn Văn Linh, a right onto Huỳnh Tấn Phát, and phà Bình Khánh at the end of that road. Tuổi Trẻ, on 30 April 2026, prints about 2 hours as the trip a future bridge would shorten. A 2019 market story also prints about 50 km. For the Cần Thạnh salt village, Dân trí prints about 30 km in the lead, about 60 km in the body of the same story, and about 30 km south from the old district centre.

From 18 March 2026 the ferry operator, Xí nghiệp Quản lý phà Thanh niên xung phong, charges 3,000 VND to walk or cycle, 8,000 VND for a motorbike, and 11,000 VND for a motorbike with a passenger. A car fare was not printed. The story says cars under 30 seats rose about 1,000–2,000 VND. The car number is check on arrival. An earlier notice, from 5 May 2025, printed a walk or bicycle at 2,000 VND, a motorbike at 7,000 VND, and a car under 7 seats at 40,000 VND. That notice does not replace the March 2026 walk and motorbike fares. A ferry clock was not opened. Check on arrival.

The ferry was still the crossing on 13 September 2026. On 30 April 2026 Tuổi Trẻ printed the bridge at about 6.3 km, six lanes, and an investment of more than 13,200 billion VND, with groundbreaking in January 2026. The 13 September story’s lead says the whole line is about 7.3 km, and later in that story about 7 km, with a bridge portion of about 3 km. A future high-speed line from Bến Thành to Cần Giờ is named in the September story. No timetable for it was opened. No airport was named. Minutes from a city airport are check on arrival.

From 1 August 2025, Phương Trang’s subsidized list includes MST 90 from Phà Bình Khánh to Cần Thạnh, MST 77 from Đồng Hòa to Cần Thạnh, and MST 128 from Tân Điền to An Nghĩa. A paying fare was not printed. Check on arrival. Free rides on that list cover children at or under 1.3 m, war wounded and sick soldiers, disabled riders, people 70 and over, and holders of a free-bus card. Visit HCMC still names route 20 to the ferry and then route 90, or route 75 direct from Công viên 23/9. Routes 20 and 75 are not on the August 2025 list. A 2019 story printed route 75 at 20,000 VND. A current fare is check on arrival. A 2019 hydrofoil from Bến Bạch Đằng to biển Cần Thạnh printed an adult one-way fare of 200,000 VND. A 2026 sailing was not opened. Check on arrival.

Sleep in xã Cần Giờ, or in the rooms the Vàm Sát tariff lists at the forest centre. No hotel brand. Vàm Sát boats leave from cầu Dần Xây. The management board is at 1541 đường Rừng Sác. A motorbike is the mode Visit HCMC and the 2019 story both describe. A hire price was not printed. Check on arrival. The bird add-on at Vàm Sát is sold from May through October. Visit HCMC puts a Tràm Chim breeding season from April through October.

stayAreas.name: The beach town
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in xã Cần Giờ, the old Cần Thạnh town and Long Hòa commune joined on 1 July 2025, if the night you want is Hàng Dương and the sand. No hotel brand.

stayAreas.name: Vàm Sát centre
stayAreas.summary: The operator prints family rooms and dorms at the forest centre, with breakfast included on the family room. No hotel brand.

eat: Hàng Dương, on đường Thạnh Thới, is the seafood market beside bãi 30 tháng 4. You choose a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. A 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m away. One seller that year said she sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00. That clock is one stall in 2019. A stall price was not printed. Check on arrival.

Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất are the sit-down streets in the old town centre, now xã Cần Giờ. The plates named there are lẩu cá dứa, the same fish simmered as cá dứa kho, tôm tích, ốc len, sò huyết, vọp, hàu nướng, and cá đuối hấp. A breakfast, a sweet, and a local drink were not named. Check on arrival. Salt is what people carry home from the pans.
interestsBody: The picture is the creek. The evening is the market and the black sand. The whale temple is the pin for lunar month 8, and a short visit on an ordinary morning.
Salt is a December–May morning on the pans. The rooms at Vàm Sát are a forest overnight.

interestGroups.title: The mangrove
interestGroups.summary: For a dry morning on the water, when the creek is the reason you came.
body: This is the mangrove biosphere UNESCO calls the city’s green lung, recognized on 21 January 2000 as Vietnam’s first biosphere reserve. Habitats on the UNESCO page are mangroves, wetlands, salt marshes, mudflats, and seagrasses. The soil is river silt from the Sài Gòn and Đồng Nai, plus a brackish water table. The board says people live in the transition zone. The core and the buffer are forest-guard households, staff, and a few traditional shrimp traps.

The size is not one number. UNESCO prints 75,740 ha and a population of 71,157 with no year on the page. The biosphere board prints 70,445.34 ha and more than 75,000 people in 2018. The biodiversity agency prints more than 75,000 hectares, with a core of 4,721 ha, a buffer of 41,139 ha, and a transition of 29,880 ha. The board’s zones differ: a core of 6,134.43 ha, a buffer of 29,152.10 ha of forest land and 12,763.56 ha of water, and a transition of 13,227.79 ha of forest land and 7,267.47 ha of water. A 2012 IUCN evaluation said 71,964 ha and 67,272 people in November 2011.

Vàm Sát is the forest centre. The tariff still says xã Lý Nhơn. From 1 July 2025 that commune sits inside xã An Thới Đông. The road gate is 60,000 VND, shuttle included, on the operator tariff and on Visit HCMC. Under 6 is free, ages 6–11 pay half, and over 11 is an adult ticket. The gate is 8:00–17:00 every day. From cầu Dần Xây the operator’s canoe is 1,075,000 VND for one person, 650,000 for two, 440,000 for three, 320,000 for four to seven, 300,000 for eight to eighteen, and 270,000 from nineteen. Visit HCMC prints that canoe leg as from 270,000 VND to 895,000 VND. A full water package on the operator’s table runs from 1,335,000 VND for one canoe down to 550,000 from nineteen. The wooden boat on that package is 445,000 from nineteen. A package without Tràm Chim is lower, from 1,260,000 for one canoe to 370,000 for a wooden boat from nineteen. Visit HCMC prints a full-service band of 550,000–1,175,000. The operator’s 1,335,000 top and Visit HCMC’s 1,175,000 top are different. Add-ons both pages print include a crocodile swamp shuttle at 20,000 VND, a caged crocodile boat at 60,000, a bird reserve at 55,000 from May through October, a rowing boat at Đầm Dơi at 65,000, and a canoe to Đầm Dơi at 185,000.

The same tariff prints a family room for two at 400,000 VND for a weekday day and 600,000 for a weekday night, or 500,000 and 750,000 on a weekend, with breakfast included. A third person is an extra 200,000 on a weekday or 250,000 on a weekend. A dorm bed is 150,000 for a weekday day and 200,000 for a weekday night, or 200,000 and 250,000 on a weekend. These are the operator’s rooms.

cards.title: Vàm Sát
cards.summary: The forest centre. Road gate 60,000 VND with the shuttle, open 8:00–17:00 every day.

cards.title: The creek
cards.summary: Dark water, mangrove trunks, and the canopy over the boat. The city skyline is not this frame.

interestGroups.title: Nghinh Ông
interestGroups.summary: For the whale rite in lunar month 8, or a short look at the temple on an ordinary morning.
body: The culture department’s page, stamped 7 November 2018, puts the festival on the 15th through the 17th of lunar month 8, with the main sea rite at 10:00 on the 16th. A 2025 city story puts 5–7 October 2025, lunar 14, 15, and 16 of month 8, and the sea rite at 9:00 on 7 October. A 2026 paper puts 23–27 September 2026, with the sea procession on 26 September and no lunar date. The next solar date is check on arrival. The 9:00 and 10:00 clocks both stay.

The palanquin of Nam Hải Đại tướng quân leaves Lăng Ông Thủy Tướng, goes to the boats, and the rite is held at tam giang khẩu. The culture department puts that point about 4 nautical miles out and writes 1 nautical mile as 1.8 km. Offerings are livestock and rice cakes, not seafood, because the fish is the spirit’s soldier. The boats return for túc yết, xây chầu, and hát bội. In 2026 more than 100 boats went. A ticket was not printed. Check on arrival. The temple keeps a whale skeleton. A length was not printed.

The biosphere board and the 2025 story both date national intangible heritage to 2013. The 2025 story also says more than 112 years of the festival. The culture department says the rite moved in 1914 from the middle of lunar month 3 to the full moon of month 8, so it sits on Tết Trung thu. The biosphere board also names Giồng Cá Vồ, Đình Cần Thạnh, Đình Dương Văn Hạnh, and Đình Bình Khánh. A gate, an hour, and a fee for those sites were not printed. Check on arrival.

cards.title: Lăng Ông
cards.summary: The whale temple in the beach town. Hours and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The Rừng Sác base
interestGroups.summary: For the rebuilt special-forces camp in this mangrove, once you are on the forest road.
body: You walk or take a canoe into the rebuilt camp. Visit HCMC names observation posts, a military workshop, an information house, hideouts, a medical station, a supply house, and figures of Unit 10, including the raid on the Nhà Bè oil depot. The biosphere board dates the national historic listing to 2004. UNESCO notes revolutionary use of the region in the wars against France and the United States. The biodiversity agency says defoliant was sprayed many times from 1964 to 1972 and that more than 80% of the old mangrove died.

Resolution 09/2020/NQ-HĐND, effective 1 January 2021, sets an adult fee of 35,000 VND a visit, domestic and foreign. Free: older people, disabled people, the armed forces, people with revolutionary merit, the veterans’ association, poor households, and children under 7. Half price: children from 7 to under 16, pupils, and students. Collection is assigned to the Củ Chi tunnels historic site. The open reprint did not show whether that resolution was still in force in 2026. Visit HCMC prints the same 35,000 VND for the combat zone and says its prices are for reference. Visit HCMC also prints a canoe at 600,000 VND a turn, round trip. The resolution does not mention a canoe. A second publisher for 600,000 was not opened.

Visit HCMC prints the Sac Forest gate as 7:30–17:30. That is not Vàm Sát’s 8:00–17:00. The same tourism page names nearly 400 battles and 860 dead, and later on the page thousands of large and small battles. Unit 10 and the years 1966 to 30 April 1975 are in the history section. The old address is đường Rừng Sác in xã Long Hòa, now part of xã Cần Giờ.

cards.title: Rừng Sác base
cards.summary: Adult 35,000 VND on the 2020 resolution and on Visit HCMC. The 2026 force of that resolution was not shown.

interestGroups.title: The town beach
interestGroups.summary: For the late afternoon, when the market is cooking and the sand is a short walk.
body: Bãi 30 tháng 4 sits beside Hàng Dương, in the old xã Long Hòa, now xã Cần Giờ. A 2019 story calls the beach still rough and about 50 m from the market, and says people sit on the shore after eating. Dân trí calls the Cần Giờ sand black from silt. A swim rule, a lifeguard hour, and a beach ticket were not printed. Check on arrival.
Go late, when the market is cooking. A tide table was not opened. A published swim flag was not opened either.

cards.title: 30 April beach
cards.summary: Black sand about 50 m from Hàng Dương. A beach ticket was not printed. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Salt pans
interestGroups.summary: For a dry-season morning, December to May, if the raking is the reason you came.
body: The pans are along đường Duyên Hải in the old town, in the fields at Lý Nhơn, now inside xã An Thới Đông, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng in xã Thạnh An. Phụ Nữ, on 10 March 2024, prints about 1,500 ha at those three places, and crystals in 7–10 days of hard sun. Dân trí, on 14 January 2020, prints about 1,200 ha in production, more than 1,000 ha on tarpaulin, a yield of 80 tons a hectare, and 7–9 days from the first crystal to harvest. Both stories put the season at December–May. Most pans now crystallize on tarpaulin, Phụ Nữ says. The city recognized the Cần Thạnh village as a traditional craft village.

Go after sunrise on a hard sunny day. Dân trí says the picture is at dawn, and that the heavy part of the job is the noon rake. Thạnh An is the island commune the 2025 resolution did not rearrange. A boat timetable, a pier name, and a fare were not opened. Check on arrival. Salt is what people carry home. No shop is named.

cards.title: The salt morning
cards.summary: December to May, after sunrise. About 1,500 ha in one story and about 1,200 ha in production in the other.

interestGroups.title: A forest day with children
interestGroups.summary: For the boat circuit inside Vàm Sát, with the child bands on that tariff.
body: Under 6 is free at the Vàm Sát road gate, ages 6–11 pay half, and over 11 is an adult ticket. The operator sells the wild-monkey reserve as a stop on its combos. Visit HCMC writes a separate Monkey Island entrance of 35,000 VND a person, the same number as the combat-zone line, and says prices are for reference. The 35,000 VND line and the 60,000 road gate are different desks.

The biosphere board prints more than 1,000 long-tailed macaques. Visit HCMC prints over 2,000 monkeys. The same tourism page describes weekend circus turns by trained monkeys and warns that they take bags and phones. That circus line was not on the operator tariff or the board. The board also prints about 2,000 birds of 33 species at Sân Chim Vàm Sát, and more than 500 bats at Đầm Dơi. Visit HCMC prints over 30 bird species and about 20,000 birds at Tràm Chim, and says that area is about 200 ha in the centre and 500 ha outside.

cards.title: The boat circuit
cards.summary: The shuttle, the monkey stop, and the child bands on the Vàm Sát tariff. Monkey counts disagree.

faqs.q: How long is the ride from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km to the forest, via Nguyễn Văn Linh and Huỳnh Tấn Phát to the Bình Khánh ferry. Tuổi Trẻ prints about 2 hours as the trip a bridge would shorten. On the water the ferry is about 10–15 minutes. A holiday queue is separate: nearly 2 hours on Huỳnh Tấn Phát on 30 April 2026, and one traveler’s nearly 3 hours including the wait.

faqs.q: Is there one ticket for the reserve?
faqs.a: No single gate was printed for the whole reserve. Vàm Sát’s road gate is 60,000 VND, shuttle included, on the operator tariff and on Visit HCMC. The Rừng Sác relic is 35,000 VND for an adult on the 2020 city resolution and on Visit HCMC. The open reprint did not show whether that resolution was still in force in 2026. A beach ticket was not printed. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can you drive the new bridge?
faqs.a: No. The ferry was still the crossing in a 13 September 2026 story. That story prints about 7.3 km in the lead and about 7 km later, with a bridge portion of about 3 km. A 30 April 2026 story prints about 6.3 km.

season.label: Dry mornings on the creek
season.note: Visit HCMC says to skip a storm day and does not name the wet months. Salt work is December–May on both salt stories. The Vàm Sát bird add-on is May through October, and Visit HCMC puts Tràm Chim breeding from April through October. Nghinh Ông sits in lunar month 8: the culture department says the 15th–17th with the sea rite at 10:00 on the 16th, a 2025 story says lunar 14–16 with the rite at 9:00, and a 2026 paper says 23–27 September with the procession on 26 September. The next solar date is check on arrival. A holiday can jam the Bình Khánh ferry. The bridge is not open.
